archetype: The Performance Pro / SOC Enterprise Dark

mono.classes: font-mono text-xs sm:text-sm tracking-tight text-zinc-400 bg-zinc-900/50 p-1 rounded-sm

visual_enhancers.borders: Use Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Expose the skeleton with 1px subtle borders (border-zinc-800).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal to none. Rely on 1px solid strokes for depth instead of soft shadows. For active states, use 2px 'Inner Glow' highlights.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky headers only: bg-zinc-950/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-zinc-800/50. No muddy grays.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the main background to prevent digital flatness.

components.Cards: Flat background (bg-zinc-900), 1px subtle border (border-zinc-800), rounded-md. Hover: border lightens to border-zinc-600.
components.Buttons: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-sm). Primary buttons use high contrast (bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200). Danger actions use red.
components.Badges: Use Shadcn badges but heavily customized with status colors (pass/fail/warning) using transparent bg + 1px colored border + colored text.
components.Tables: Dense layout. Use monospaced font for ID/Hash columns. Sticky header.
components.Tabs: Underline style or sharp pill style. Active state should have high contrast.

layouts.container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 w-full
layouts.navigation: Sticky top-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-between h-16

responsive.layout: Stack elements vertically on mobile. Use hidden/block classes to swap complex tables for card-based lists on screens < 768px.
responsive.typography: Scale down h1 to text-3xl on mobile. Ensure body copy is at least 16px to prevent iOS zoom.
responsive.overflow_guard: Use overflow-x-auto on tables or pre/code blocks. Ensure main container has overflow-x-hidden.
responsive.tap_targets: Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, links, table rows) have a minimum height of 44px on mobile.

motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform duration-200. NO transition-all.
motion.interactions: Buttons scale down slightly on active: active:scale-95. Rows have subtle bg change on hover.
motion.feedback: Use Framer Motion for Tamper Demonstration: when a field is tampered, the hash string should visually 'scramble' or flash red (bg-red-500/20) to draw attention.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against dark backgrounds meets APCA/WCAG AA minimums (pure white or zinc-300 on zinc-950).
accessibility.aria: Use aria-live regions for the Tamper Demonstration results (Pass/Fail).

media.strategy: Minimal images. This is an enterprise console. Rely on typography, grid lines, and data visualization.
media.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a technical, crisp look. Duotone or Regular weight.

3d_libraries.strategy: No complex 3D required for this MVP to keep it fast. If a visual is needed for the 'Hash Chain Continuity', use D3.js or a simple HTML/CSS flex layout with arrows (Phosphor icons) connecting blocks.

image_urls.description: Optional: Extremely low opacity (5%) background texture for the main header to add a subtle tech/data vibe.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Context: Build a React web app with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI. The app is an 'Aura-Guard Compliance Auditor'.
2. Data Mocking: Implement a built-in JSON sample dataset with deterministic demo data. DO NOT make external API calls.
3. Dashboard View: Create KPI cards (total, compliant, warnings, violations). Use Grid layout.
4. Audit View: A list/table of AI decisions. Include policy status, reason, timestamp, and short evidence hash.

5. Evidence Verification View: A detailed split-view or modal. Show checks for canonical representation, SHA-256 integrity, hash-chain, and policy version. Clearly indicate PASS/FAIL states using the defined status colors.

6. Tamper Flow (CRITICAL): Build an interactive demo. Allow the user to edit a field in the JSON payload on the UI. Upon editing, immediately trigger a re-validation that causes the SHA-256 integrity check to FAIL (turn red).
7. Report View: A clean, printable summary view of the audit session. Hide navigation and dark theme strictly for printing if possible, or keep it monochrome.
8. Mobile First: The dashboard MUST be usable on mobile. Convert the audit table into a vertical stack of cards on small screens (md:hidden for table, hidden md:block for cards).
9. Test IDs: MUST add data-testid attributes to all buttons, inputs, and major UI containers (e.g., data-testid='upload-json-btn', data-testid='tamper-input').
10. Dependencies: Install @phosphor-icons/react for icons. Use sonner for toasts.
11. Styling: Ensure NO transparent backgrounds on headers. Use bg-zinc-950/80 with backdrop-blur. Avoid overusing soft shadows; rely on 1px borders.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT use universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use emojis as icons. Use the specified icon library.
Create depth through z-index and border styling, not heavy shadows (in this dark theme).
Ensure hover states and focus rings are distinct and accessible.
Use 2-3x more spacing for layouts to avoid cramped designs, but keep data tables dense.
